title: Fix workspace installation and Python 3.14 startup; establish the Phase 1 baseline.
body:
Example-targeted installs could omit or remove Plato, and fresh Python 3.14 startup failed without a current event loop. This change makes workspace installs reproducible and client/server startup execute scheduled work with explicit loop ownership and failure propagation.

- Track `uv.lock`, refresh tested dependency bounds, and link all 15 workspace examples to local Plato. Separate base, test/dev, build/docs/audit and optional profiles; SSL and Lighteval require separate environments.
- Keep Python 3.13 as default/minimum, with tested core 3.14 forward compatibility.
- Enforce test prerequisites and exact omissions, restore fixture state after exceptions, and preserve focused pytest selections. Add bounded Ubuntu 3.13/3.14 CPU jobs with separate environments and retained logs.

[Fresh root validation](https://github.com/TL-System/plato/blob/maintenance/2026-refresh-audit/evidence/2026-refresh/phase1-integration-validation.json) after integrating `80539c3`, on Apple Silicon macOS:

| Check | Python 3.13.16 | Python 3.14.8 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full mandatory, including startup | 298 passed; 1 skip | 298 passed; 1 skip |
| Base, excluding startup | 246 passed; 4 skip reports | 246 passed; 4 skip reports |
| Pytest warnings | 0 | 0 |

Mandatory executes all 48 startup cases plus DP/MPC and initialized Nanochat training; only the absent native tokenizer skips. Base omissions represent two DP and three Nanochat nodes. Fresh CPU socket rounds train separate clients on 2/6 samples; received payloads match independently recomputed weighted aggregates. Clients exit naturally. Five expected containments per interpreter leave no live survivors; cooperative lifecycle tests separately verify finalization. Watchdog termination does not establish graceful cleanup.

Locked installation, Ruff, build and workflow typing checks pass; wheel runtime sources match the checkout. Typing retains 404 classified diagnostics, not a clean repository. Independent task reviews and the [Phase 1 gate](https://github.com/TL-System/plato/blob/maintenance/2026-refresh-audit/evidence/2026-refresh/phase1-gate.json) passed; [focused-selection and clean-output typing corrections](https://github.com/TL-System/plato/blob/maintenance/2026-refresh-audit/evidence/2026-refresh/phase1c-review2.json) are resolved. Linux execution remains pending publication and is required before Phase 2.

The authorized uv override selects NLTK 3.10.3 despite Lighteval's 3.9.1 pin, retaining the metadata conflict and unsuppressed PYSEC-2026-3740 / CVE-2026-81726 advisory. Tested BLEU/ROUGE pass; ordinary wheel/sdist dependency resolution still selects 3.9.1 without the override.

Optional backends remain separately qualified. Core bug fixes, MLX, examples, archives and docs remain later phases under the [accepted addendum](https://github.com/TL-System/plato/blob/maintenance/2026-refresh-audit/evidence/2026-refresh/plan-addendum.json). ViT archival replaces repair; legacy archival is authorized. No files have moved.

current_validation.delivery_summary: 1A, 1B and final 1C are accepted; the local Phase 1 gate and fresh root integration validation PASS. Description is ready for publication. Published Linux CPU verification remains required before Phase 2 or cleanup.
current_validation.environment: Root checkout, Apple Silicon macOS 27.0, Python 3.13.16 and 3.14.8, locked dev and test-base profiles. Python default/minimum remains 3.13; 3.14 evidence is core forward compatibility.
current_validation.warnings: Zero pytest warnings in each fresh mandatory/base run; no fork-warning suppression.
current_validation.skip_contract: Mandatory permits only absent callable rustbpe.Tokenizer for its named round-trip test; DP/MPC and both initialized Nanochat trainer tests execute. Four base skip reports represent two DP nodes in one module plus three Nanochat nodes. Base partitions out 48 startup cases; full mandatory executes them all.
current_validation.runtime: 48 fresh root runtime results per interpreter, including actual socket rounds with two trained clients and 2/6 sample weights. Root independently recomputed W0 + (2*(W1-W0)+6*(W2-W0))/8 from received tensors within rtol=1e-5/atol=1e-6. Both clients return naturally; five expected watchdog containments per interpreter, no live survivors.
current_validation.lifecycle_boundary: Production success retains os._exit; separate cooperative tests cover finalization. Forced containment does not prove graceful cleanup or original-error delivery from noncooperative extension code.
current_validation.static_and_artifacts: Locked syncs, Ruff, wheel/sdist build, diff check and workflow typing classification gate pass. Wheel plato/client.py and plato/servers/base.py match integrated runtime sources. Reviewed workflow syntax checks passed; no Linux execution is inferred.
current_validation.review_corrections: P1C-R01 and P1C-R02 independently resolved: ordinary focused selections retain pytest behavior while explicit profiles enforce qualification; typing checker accepts verified clean output and classified nonzero output while rejecting malformed/tool-failure/unexpected-owned diagnostics.
current_validation.coverage: Not recollected by root. Retained 1C mandatory-core coverage is about 43.30% on each interpreter, excluding startup subprocesses. Comparable 219 unchanged files improved from 44.175% to 44.965%; raw baseline/final denominators differ.
current_validation.dependency_exception: Authorized workspace uv override uses NLTK 3.10.3 against Lighteval 3.9.1 metadata. Expected metadata-check failure and PYSEC-2026-3740 / CVE-2026-81726 remain visible; no published fix in retained audit. Tested metrics do not qualify arbitrary tasks. Ordinary wheel/sdist resolution selects 3.9.1 without the override; optional artifact contents depend on submodule initialization.
current_validation.evidence_boundary: Fresh root full-suite/runtime results supersede retained candidate runtime results for final local validation. Gate and root validation are complete; Linux execution and later-phase support are not claimed.

pending_final_inputs: Post-publication GitHub Ubuntu CPU results for Python 3.13 and 3.14, required before Phase 2 or cleanup. No further local input is pending for publishing this description.
